title: Gantry module manifest
description: gantry-module.json: identity and capabilities of a Gantry module, embedded in its provider command and printed by `<provider> gantry manifest`.

namespace.description: Unique id across installed modules; used verbatim as the docs route prefix (/<namespace>/...).

title.description: Display name shown by `gantry module list` and as the docs sidebar heading.

module.description: The Go module path, e.g. github.com/BlueBeard63/WhiteGantry.

version.description: Informational. The authoritative installed version is what the Go toolchain resolves at install time.

gantry.description: Minimum framework version constraint, e.g. ">=0.4.0". Checked against the running gantry CLI at install.

provides.description: The capabilities this module contributes. At least one is required.

docs.description: A tree of markdown pages merged into `gantry docs` under the route prefix.

prefix.description: Optional; defaults to /<namespace> and must equal it when set.

title.description: Optional docs sidebar/category label; defaults to the module title.

lib.description: An importable Go package apps depend on; drives the optional go.mod prompt.

import.description: The import path apps use, e.g. github.com/BlueBeard63/WhiteGantry.
